open_threads: After the 59th session concludes on 10 July 2026, does the A/CN.9-series session report record adoption, referral back, or noting of A/CN.9/1246? (A/CN.9/1269 companion comments compilation confirmed on agenda as of June 30.)

Does any State adopting the Protocol/MIIR opt to apply the early-dismissal provisions to pre-existing treaties, which would for the first time give a harmonised jurisdictional-gate tool to IP-investment respondents?

Can the opt-in / non-retroactivity architecture be confirmed from the body of A/CN.9/1246 itself? (Partial advance June 30: search-engine summary suggests 'treaties concluded on or after 1 April 2027' as the temporal scope — unconfirmed at primary text level; attempt UN ODS access at https://documents.un.org.)

Does an accessible primary source for the Hela Schwarz award emerge? (Award December 10, 2025; underlying dispute is a real estate/land-use case in Shandong, not pharmaceutical; ICSID and italaw PDFs both 403-blocked.)
Is there any new signal on the Einarsson award beyond the prior baseline of post-hearing briefing through August 2025?

Can the full text of the Swedish Supreme Court's June 15, 2026 Okuashvili decision be accessed beyond the paywalled IAReporter headline? (Three-instance chain confirmed: SCC Partial Award August 2022 → Svea annulment November 2024 → Supreme Court reversal June 15, 2026; SCC jurisdiction restored; underlying dispute is tobacco sector, no IP nexus.)
